title: Mendelian randomization for HDL and heart attack
content: Figure 7.12 uses HDL genotype as an instrument for HDL levels while Lifestyle confounds HDL levels and heart-attack risk.

variables.name: HDL Gene
variables.content: A genetic variant assigned at conception and used as the instrument.

variables.name: Lifestyle
variables.content: Behavioral causes shared by HDL levels and heart-attack risk.

variables.name: HDL Levels
variables.content: The biological exposure whose causal effect is queried.

arrows.because: The selected genetic variant changes HDL levels.
The diagram poses HDL levels as a possible cause of heart attack.
